text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hello... Hello... This is Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Lost coordinates to victory. Can't even 
see the "beacon"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The radio waves known as 'me'... are 
drifting through the coldness of space."
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I will guide you.

Even if we have to struggle, let's keep 
moving forward!

text_block_list.text: The "Event Horizon"... to the other side.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Even within "absolute zero," 
there is "heat" somewhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Convergence"... "Radiation"... Repeating. 
Only beyond endurance... is there 
"Arrival."
